title: Omega-3 Fatty Acids in Treating Patients With Advanced Cancer Who Have Significant Weight Loss

sections.abstract: RATIONALE: Omega-3 fatty acids are used by the body for energy and tissue development and may be an effective treatment for patients with advanced cancer who are unable to maintain their body weight. PURPOSE: Phase I/II trial to study the effectiveness of omega-3 fatty acids in treating patients with advanced cancer who have significant weight loss.
